scope: Evidence, calculations, disagreement, scoped readiness and retrieval
status: implemented; integrated validation is tracked by root

findings.change: Synthesis/audit disagreements become disputed unknown verdicts with separate positive/adverse citations and both assessors. Explicit human attestation cannot erase an existing unresolved conflict.

Each planned objective receives a fair remaining page allowance; fetched sources reserve passage slots. Full evidence slots or an exhausted48K canonical initial context budget prevent unusable searches. Context projection is checked before each optional passage persists; shortfalls are explicit.

Claim support bases require all premises within a basis and accept alternative bases. Contradicted/mixed/not_checked ancestors cannot transmit supported status, including same-response aliases. Explicit counter-bases preserve uncertainty; reuse drops incomplete bases and downgrades lost support.

Full bounded objection ledger records opening and response provenance. Missing dispositions remain open; resolution requires an explicit distinct audit of a prior answer with scoped references. Critical findings precede optional dissent; overflow is counted and full issues remain in reports.

Owner-scoped idempotent assessment endpoint binds target hashes, exact evidence hashes, result, validity and an explicit attestation. All compared costs and selected noncost hard requirements need scoped acceptance. Reassessment creates a new immutable report without inference and never changes a source-wide verification label.
Locally ranked exact-offset windows include requirement terms and exception anchors, retain source/content hashes and omitted coverage, and preserve contiguous exact chunks when the full source fits.

additional_implementation.decision_insights: Deterministic cost frontier only among matching assessed constraints, signed budget margins and ordinal preference order. No cardinal preference weights or probability scores are invented.
additional_implementation.readiness_dimensions: Separately exposes complete inputs, arithmetic, scoped cost support, requirement acceptance, review separation and unresolved obligations.
additional_implementation.compatibility: Saved historical report bytes are not rewritten. Additive schemas retain defaults; old claim hashes are checked over the stored field set using exclude_unset. New reports declare scoped_evidence_obligations_v1.

initial_expanded_suite.failure: Existing capacity/dedup fixture stored only origin_group and was rejected by the new exact-context evidence reader.

additional_observed_runs: 110 focused evidence/report tests passed before the final48K context projection change.
20 retrieval/evidence/reserve tests passed after initial and per-passage48K context projection.

fixture_upgrades_not_weakened_assertions: Claim ancestry test explicitly marks its supplied source user_supplied rather than omitting status.
Expired-cost worker mock emits claims only after confirmed intake, and expects five claim-producing stages rather than six; all expired-cost and unchecked-status assertions remain.
Synthetic ready-report fixture supplies scoped attestation receipts and dimensions instead of treating review quorum alone as ready.
Capacity/dedup fixture supplies complete valid evidence identities, hash, exact text, dates and scope; original capacity and dedup assertions remain.
Research fixture explicitly registers ClaimVersion before create_all so isolated tests create the newly read imported-claim context table.
limits: These algorithms preserve declared evidence scope and procedural uncertainty; semantic entailment and factual accuracy still require independently annotated real-provider/human evaluation.
Readiness under owner attestation is explicitly not independent supplier certification.
Lexical relevance and exception coverage are deterministic heuristics, not a measured probability of relevance or complete-document verification.
